title: Antibody-Mediated Rejection in Cardiac Transplantation: Emerging Knowledge in Diagnosis and Management
study_context: AHA scientific statement endorsed by ISHLT on cardiac antibody-mediated rejection.
population_or_data: Clinical and pathology evidence on AMR diagnosis, surveillance, and management.
task: Summarize pathological AMR nomenclature and clinical interpretation.
method: Expert scientific statement and evidence synthesis.
main_findings: Pathological AMR categories combine histological and immunopathological findings from pAMR0 through pAMR3.
A histology-negative but immunopathology-positive category and the converse are explicitly recognized.
limitations: The statement spans diagnosis and treatment and is not an image-only model validation study.
does_not_establish: H&E morphology alone cannot be treated as equivalent to the full pAMR classification.
relevance_to_project: Defines what an H&E-only or stain-limited AMR model can and cannot claim.
